53: /// Read and watch domain entities by id within a tenant.
54: ///
55: /// The read side of the entity plane (`EntityService`): `get` returns the latest
56: /// materialized `EntityChange` for an entity; `watch` streams subsequent changes.
57: /// Tenant scoping is a required argument — an implementation MUST NOT return an entity
58: /// belonging to a different tenant than the one requested.
59: ///
60: /// Adapter crates MUST instrument their implementations with
61: /// `#[tracing::instrument(name = "port::EntityStore::<method>")]`.
62: #[async_trait]
63: pub trait EntityStore: Send + Sync + 'static {
64:     /// Fetch the latest known change for an entity within a tenant.
65:     /// Returns `Ok(None)` when the entity is unknown to this tenant.
66:     async fn get_entity(
67:         &self,
68:         entity_id: EntityId,
69:         tenant_id: TenantId,
70:     ) -> Result<Option<EntityChange>, PortError>;
71: 
72:     /// Stream subsequent changes for an entity within a tenant. The stream ends when the
73:     /// subscription is dropped; each item is one `EntityChange`.
74:     async fn watch_entity(
75:         &self,
76:         entity_id: EntityId,
77:         tenant_id: TenantId,
78:     ) -> Result<EntityChangeStream, PortError>;
79: 
80:     /// Atomically apply one committed mutation and advance its durable cursor.
81:     async fn apply_projection(
82:         &self,
83:         change: EntityChange,
84:         cursor: ProjectionCursor,
85:     ) -> Result<ProjectionApply, PortError>;
86: 
87:     /// Atomically apply a mutation to both the v1 projection and the lossless
88:     /// typed representation used by `WatchEntityType`.
89:     async fn apply_typed_projection(
90:         &self,
91:         projection: TypedEntityProjection,
92:         cursor: ProjectionCursor,
93:     ) -> Result<ProjectionApply, PortError> {
94:         self.apply_projection(projection.change, cursor).await
95:     }
96: 
97:     /// Capture current rows for one approved type and the inclusive cursor in
98:     /// the same store boundary. Adapters without typed projection support fail
99:     /// closed rather than synthesizing a partial snapshot.
100:     async fn snapshot_entity_type(
101:         &self,
102:         _entity_type: &EntityTypeSelector,
103:         _tenant_id: TenantId,
104:     ) -> Result<EntityTypeProjectionSnapshot, PortError> {
105:         Err(PortError::NotFound(
106:             "resnapshot_required: typed entity projection is unavailable".to_owned(),
107:         ))
108:     }
109: 
110:     /// Install a current-state snapshot and its inclusive WAL/broker boundary.
111:     /// Returns false when an equal or newer projection already exists.
112:     async fn install_projection_snapshot(
113:         &self,
114:         snapshot: EntityProjectionSnapshot,
115:     ) -> Result<bool, PortError>;
116: 
117:     /// Return the last state-and-cursor position committed by this projection.
118:     async fn projection_checkpoint(&self) -> Result<Option<ProjectionCursor>, PortError>;
